title: Atlantis World
tagline: A virtual world where you can live, work, play + earn: we are building the first lightweight metaverse enabling interactive, token-gated community spaces powered by secure DeFi.
how_its_made:
Phaser -> Game framework. 





IPFS / NFT.storage -> Storing game assets on-chain + React UI for adding / modifying assets / meta-data.





Moralis API -> MetaMask wallet connect, token-gating.





Aave -> In-game interactions with Aave protocol + use of sub-graph powered by Graph Protocol.





Polygon -> Matic mainnet.





Audius -> In-game music streaming.
